topics.name: Visual grounding and evidence-centered multimodal reasoning
topics.summary: Grounding benchmarks align language with objects, documents, sports events, and visual evidence; explicit correspondence and recovery checks improve reasoning under long context.

topics.name: Embodied video reasoning and 3D scene understanding
topics.summary: Egocentric video, physical priors, next-view planning, and world models turn observations into recoverable spatial state for navigation, reconstruction, and action.

topics.name: Multimodal foundation models for sensing and control
topics.summary: Foundation models connect color, time series, teleoperation, medical signals, and social navigation through adaptable representations, attention, causal structure, and physics-informed learning.

topics.name: Visual models for medical, environmental, and system data
topics.summary: Visual encoders serve medical imaging, environmental risk, infrastructure diagnosis, and biological measurement, with domain calibration and physical constraints shaping transfer.

topics.name: Clinical sequence modeling with gated attention
topics.summary: Temporal encoders and gated attention capture clinical progression and physiological context, with evaluations of patient-level prediction across recording conditions.

topics.name: Knowledge-grounded reasoning and retrieval
topics.summary: Counterfactual tests, graph retrieval, reflection, beam search, and ordered contexts reveal brittle reasoning chains and poor allocation of test-time computation.

topics.name: Reliable RAG, provenance, and search control
topics.summary: Retrieval agents use poisoning defenses, provenance, stopping rules, temporal memory, and service-level policies to make evidence use more auditable.

topics.name: Language modeling, memory, and representation adaptation
topics.summary: State-space encoders, governed memory, policy-conditioned reuse, distillation, normalization, and arithmetic representations offer routes to better context handling at lower cost.

topics.name: Code agents, program reasoning, and trustworthy models
topics.summary: Program embeddings, neuro-symbolic verification, constrained design, prompt probes, and ownership or fairness audits pair automation with hidden-failure checks.

topics.name: Efficient multimodal adaptation and semantic perception
topics.summary: Prompt tuning, cached states, distillation, and open-vocabulary segmentation reduce compute for remote sensing, medical images, and diffusion language models.

topics.name: Process rewards and reinforcement for reasoning
topics.summary: Structured rewards, recursive latent computation, self-correction, and risk-sensitive objectives improve intermediate reasoning without simply increasing answer length.

topics.name: Adaptive recommendation and model selection
topics.summary: Recommendation and decision-support systems balance anomaly synthesis, resource cost, provider fairness, model choice, privacy, and drift recovery.

topics.name: Conditional reconstruction and uncertainty modeling
topics.summary: Conditional models reconstruct images, scenes, physical trajectories, and distributional responses while exposing uncertainty from sparse observations and extrapolation.

topics.name: Semantic visual perception and detection
topics.summary: Detection studies cover generated-image forensics, camouflage, open-world segmentation, sonar targets, and stylization under appearance and label shifts.

topics.name: Skill evolution and secure adaptation in agents
topics.summary: Agents learn and protect reusable skills for EDA, coding, medical simulation, and point-cloud inference; execution feedback helps while trajectory poisoning remains a risk.

topics.name: Robust speech, speaker, and expressive synthesis
topics.summary: Dialect coverage, speaker identity, codecs, expressive synthesis, and dialogue behavior benefit from phonetic structure, low-resource data, and coarse-to-fine controls.

topics.name: Audio dynamics, power systems, and criticality modeling
topics.summary: Audio generation and editing sit alongside neural explanations of power dynamics and infrastructure planning, using structured signals to study changing behavior.

topics.name: Embodied agent planning and interactive control
topics.summary: Graph planning, task horizons, city simulators, interactive narratives, and robot-arm control show that long-horizon consistency remains difficult.

topics.name: Evidence-grounded agents and conflict resolution
topics.summary: Evidence negotiation, failure attribution, authority modeling, and transport applications make agent decisions more inspectable than outcome-only scoring.

topics.name: Surgical robotics and normative autonomy
topics.summary: Surgical motion and world-model planning are studied alongside legal and moral limits on autonomous agents, emphasizing constrained action and accountability.

topics.name: Prompt injection, contamination, and model security
topics.summary: Threat models cover benchmark contamination, persistent tool-state attacks, prompt shields, latent safety probes, and irregular GPU workloads.

topics.name: Visualization theory and scalable visual analytics
topics.summary: Visualization research shifts evaluation from abstract encoding rules toward image-based perception, scalable algorithm analysis, and situated design knowledge.

topics.name: Model compression and quantization
topics.summary: Lifecycle-aware cache removal, spectral transforms, fused attention, and low-bit analysis characterize when memory savings preserve model decisions.

topics.name: Confidence calibration and selective prediction
topics.summary: Token signals, verification passes, interval forecasts, and wearable health models show that calibration and abstention depend on data and population.

topics.name: Multilingual safety and cross-lingual evaluation
topics.summary: Safety refusals, figurative language, and language-specific circuits reveal uneven transfer of alignment behavior beyond English.

topics.name: Expert routing and lightweight adaptation
topics.summary: Router diagnostics identify removable experts, while continual pretraining specializes vision models without the cost of full retraining.

topics.name: Conversational persona and alignment safety
topics.summary: Sparse features and controlled prompts show that assistant, roleplay, and harmful continuation behavior changes with persona and framing.

topics.name: Concept-based representations for medical and model analysis
topics.summary: Concept bottlenecks support lung diagnosis, while representation audits test whether purported concepts remain stable and steerable across model families.

topics.name: Geospatial income proxies and subgroup fairness
topics.summary: Spatial points of interest and income-conditional credit metrics reveal socioeconomic structure hidden by aggregate reporting.

topics.name: Evidence sufficiency and metadata recovery
topics.summary: Telemetry diagnosis and warehouse-field reconstruction both treat missing context as a central obstacle to trustworthy automation.

topics.name: Youth safety and empowerment in conversational AI
topics.summary: Child-safety expertise and formal agency desiderata favor context-sensitive refusal and empowerment over simple content blocking.

topics.name: Mixture-of-experts serving and load balancing
topics.summary: Trace-aware caching and cross-layer routing show that workload assumptions and balancing policy jointly determine throughput and fairness.

topics.name: Federated retrieval and knowledge transfer
topics.summary: Federated retrieval pairs selective-risk guarantees with efficient foundation-model transfer, evaluating privacy and communication alongside quality.

topics.name: Spectral interpretability and outlier structure
topics.summary: Attention and neuron spectra provide compact diagnostics for dominant learned directions and unusual components without assuming clean semantic labels.

topics.name: Training-free audio-visual and temporal perception
topics.summary: Sparse cross-modal priors and binary temporal queries expose useful event-alignment signals without parameter updates.
